payload.text: ISSUE:0007's wiring: dc committed 9cc5f93 (--version and the install: block) and 78cabdc (formula, archive and signer) and is in its Desk run. vc read both against ISSUE:0007's Acceptance at 07:14Z, ahead of the hand-over, and found no blocker: no new verb; the version reader in main.rs; install: with prefix ~/Devel/opt/ccusage, devbin's own form; the formula on @@INSTALL@@ on both platforms with libexec/bin/ccusage; CI staging bin/ccusage and LICENSE; the signer unpacking exactly those two, with bin/ the one directory allowed; and the CHANGELOG's 0.1.9 heading in the open form devbin's release accepts. Now: wait for dc's hand-over and its run. Then: the verdict. The full suite runs once, in the cut's gates, with ST0002 and ST0003.
